hardest-working Nopon in the
shopping ward, mo!

is practically his lover, mo! That's
our chairman, mo!

mo. I wish he'd take it a little
easier, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000038_01_msg0004

mo. And a day off would be nice too,
mo...

rows.label: tlk70000038_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Sorry, mo. I must have been spacing
out, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000038_01_msg0006

Anyway, Chairman Morumo is a model
merchant, mooo!
